verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Airbyte replicating source DELETE/INSERT/UPDATE events via CDC and syncing schema changes, but there is no documentation of user-facing controls for data retention periods, workspace/connection data deletion, or log/record purging that would let a user manage privacy-oriented data retention. A community question (airbyte-comm-2) even highlights an unanswered gap around how hard deletions are handled, but this doesn't rise to a documented capability failure — it's simply absent from the evidence.
